scope: Execution hot-path refactor and dead-export removal; no user-facing capability was removed.
changes: Cached the immutable run -> session binding inside Store, removing a JSON/SQLite lookup from every streamed event.
Added Store.emitEphemeral: non-durable deltas are allocated and redacted only when a live subscriber exists; headless runs skip them entirely.
Added redactJsonText and used it for provider request bodies, normalized tool results, transcript appends and store writes, removing a full JSON parse/serialization round trip per operation.
Added Store.write for callers that do not need a redacted parsed copy (run status, inbox, effects, work contexts, recovery records).
ToolExecution reuses the prepared/running effect record instead of re-reading it; Engine snapshots its tool array once per run.
Input idempotency digests are computed only when clientMessageId is present.
Added the missing cost-ledger UTC-day expression index; generic entity indexes already cover run/session/project filters.
Centralized process environment filtering, Node pipe compatibility and host application access policy helpers.
Removed genuinely unused exports: office csvText, MCP publicMetadataResponse and servers ExecInput.
Added --compile-only to scripts/run-core-tests.mjs so validation can compile once and run files independently.

rejectedExperiment.change: INSERT ... ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING for transcript appends
rejectedExperiment.result: Reverted: Node 22 node:sqlite measured ~70x slower than SELECT-before-INSERT for conflicting rows (788ms vs 11ms for 4,000 conflicts x5 rounds).

sourceLines.method: Physical lines, including blanks and comments, for TS/JS/MJS/CJS under the maintained directories.
sourceLines.interpretation: The codebase has no unreferenced exports left. A whole-repo reference analysis found zero additionally removable exports. The requested 20,000-line total cannot be reached without deleting capabilities or tests: even formatting every file at 200 columns leaves 48,305 lines, and src alone at 200 columns leaves 23,581 lines.

verification.coreTests: 454 pass / 1 fail of 455; the only failure is a missing local git executable in the environment, not a code regression.
verification.hostIntegrationTests: 30 pass / 3 fail of 33; failures are environment-bound: two Chromium extension service-worker timeouts and one Windows foreground-focus denial.
verification.build: npm run build and npm run build:host passed.
verification.typecheck: npm run check and npm run check:host passed.
verification.sourceCheck: npm run verify:source passed: 314 source files, no agent-framework dependencies and no production fixture adapters.
verification.compiledSmoke: test/smoke.compiled.mjs and test/smoke-host.compiled.mjs passed, including actual Chromium and the Windows bridge.
verification.baselineComparison: The pre-change baseline under the same test runner was 454 pass / 1 fail after optional ssh2 was installed; the 11 ssh2 tests were skipped in the earlier optional-deps-absent run.

limitations: No third-party paid model, OAuth provider or external MCP service was exercised.
Host browser-extension and native UI failures are environmental; source for those paths was not changed.
Microbenchmarks exclude network and model latency and are not end-to-end agent throughput measurements.
The 20,000-line target was not met and was not claimed; reaching it would require removing features or maintaining fewer tests.
